papers.title: Importance Resampling for Global Illumination
papers.problem: How can Monte Carlo variance be reduced when a target distribution is easy to evaluate but difficult to sample directly?
contributions: Applies importance resampling to lighting integrals and derives the corresponding RIS estimator.
Analyzes the tradeoff between the number of candidates and the number of final samples.
papers.changes: Provides the estimator foundation for later reservoir resampling, without the cross-pixel or cross-frame reuse introduced by ReSTIR.
limitations: Candidates still have to be generated and evaluated, so their cost limits the benefit of resampling.
This map includes the EGSR paper; the master's thesis with the same title is not a separate node.
